propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain eligible for execution even after the run is canceled, causing stale matrix and reusable work to consume runner-seconds past replacement creation.

Commit 6f4123678c added always() predicates to seven full-route jobs, breaking the same-change cancel-in-progress contract; live run pair 31834162663→31834896849 demonstrates 1,510 seconds of successor delay and 1,785 runner-seconds consumed after replacement.

The fix must replace only the cancellation-status portion of the seven full-route predicates with !cancelled() checks while preserving all other conditions (clear-vote, ticket, classifier-result, route) byte-for-byte.

Classifier-failure fallback and vote-job cancellation-aware behavior must remain unchanged; a failed classifier must still launch the full fallback route as a blocking result, and a canceled run must still be normalized and reported.

Acceptance criteria include RED/GREEN/mutation proof of the workflow-contract regression test, successful gates (YAML/actionlint/lint/typecheck), and live evidence from organic same-change replacements showing prompt cancellation and successor admission without waiting for natural matrix completion.
